insight: 洞见；深刻理解（复数 insights）
attach: 附上；把…和…连在一起（过去分词 attached）
enjoy: 享受；喜欢（过去分词 enjoyed）

items.s: That is ___ wisdom, that may even be the practical earned experience of your reality.
items.why: 后面是名词 wisdom，用来描述它，所以填形容词。
items.src: That is conventional wisdom, that may even be the practical earned experience of your reality.

items.s: In most countries, the ___ way to say hello is a handshake.
items.why: the ___ way：冠词和名词 way 中间，描述名词，填形容词。

items.s: That is conventional wisdom, that may even be the ___ earned experience of your reality.
items.why: the ___ … experience：冠词后、名词前，描述名词，填形容词。
items.src: That is conventional wisdom, that may even be the practical earned experience of your reality.

items.s: I try to ___ my English every day.
items.why: try to 后面接动词原形，填动词。

items.s: I'm ___ done with my last client.
items.why: 修饰 done（几乎做完），描述程度，填副词。

items.s: You're an animal, you're here to survive, you're here to ___, you're driven, you're motivated.
items.why: to 后面接动词原形，填动词。
items.src: You’re an animal, you’re here to survive, you’re here to replicate, you’re driven, you’re motivated, you’re gonna do something.

items.s: It's hard to ___ the exact same lash look on every client.
items.why: to 后面接动词原形，后面还有宾语 the look，填动词。

items.s: You're here to replicate, you're ___, you're motivated, you're gonna do something.
items.why: you're 后面描述人的状态，填形容词 driven（有干劲的）。
items.src: You’re an animal, you’re here to survive, you’re here to replicate, you’re driven, you’re motivated, you’re gonna do something.

items.s: She's very ___; she works on her business every night.
items.why: very 后面、描述人，填形容词。

items.s: You're here to replicate, you're driven, you're ___, you're going to do something.
items.why: you're 后面描述人的状态，填形容词。
items.src: You’re an animal, you’re here to survive, you’re here to replicate, you’re driven, you’re motivated, you’re gonna do something.

items.s: Money is not my only ___.
items.why: my only 后面需要一个“东西”，填名词。

items.s: Good teachers ___ their students.
items.why: 主语 teachers 后面缺动作，填动词。

items.s: I want to do things that are more pure, more ___ with what I think needs to be done and what I can uniquely do.
items.why: are more ___ with：be 动词 + more 后面描述事物，填形容词（aligned with 和…一致）。
items.src: I want to do things that are more pure, more aligned with what I think needs to be done and what I can uniquely do.

items.s: Make sure your goals are ___ with your values.
items.why: are 后面描述 goals 的状态，填形容词。

items.s: I want to do things that are more pure, more aligned with what I think needs to be done and what I can ___ do.
items.why: 修饰后面的动词 do，填副词。
items.src: I want to do things that are more pure, more aligned with what I think needs to be done and what I can uniquely do.

items.s: Every client's eyes are ___.
items.why: be 动词 are 后面描述主语，填形容词。

items.s: So in that sense I think that being happier can actually make you more ___.
items.why: make you more ___：描述人的状态，填形容词。
items.src: So in that sense I think that being happier can actually make you more successful, but your definition of success will likely change along the way.

items.s: You will ___ if you keep trying.
items.why: will 后面接动词原形，填动词。

items.s: Your ___ of success will likely change along the way.
items.why: your ___ of：所有格后面需要名词，填名词。
items.src: So in that sense I think that being happier can actually make you more successful, but your definition of success will likely change along the way.

items.s: It ___ depends on your goal.
items.why: 主语和动词 depends 中间，修饰动词，填副词。

items.s: Your definition of success will ___ change along the way.
items.why: will 和动词 change 中间，修饰动词，这里 likely 作副词（很可能）。
items.src: So in that sense I think that being happier can actually make you more successful, but your definition of success will likely change along the way.

items.s: There's a high ___ of rain today.
items.why: a high ___ of：形容词 high 后面需要名词，填名词。

items.s: Is that a ___ you think you could have gotten to had you not had some success?
items.why: a 后面需要一个名词（领悟），填名词。
items.src: Is that a realization you think you could have gotten to had you not had some success in the first place?

items.s: I suddenly ___ that I was wrong.
items.why: 主语 I 后面缺动作，过去发生，填动词过去式。

items.s: I was not going to go be an ascetic and sit there and renounce everything. That just seems too ___ and too painful.
items.why: seems too ___：seem 是系动词，后面接形容词。
items.src: I was not going to go be an ascetic and sit there and renounce everything. That just seems too unrealistic and too painful.

items.s: ___, we can't finish everything by Friday.
items.why: 句首、用逗号隔开，修饰整个句子，填副词。

items.s: I was not going to go be an ascetic and sit there and ___ everything.
items.why: and 连接两个动作 sit and ___，后面有宾语 everything，填动词。
items.src: I was not going to go be an ascetic and sit there and renounce everything. That just seems too unrealistic and too painful.

items.s: He chose to ___ his old habits.
items.why: to 后面接动词原形，填动词。

items.s: I'll take the happy route that ___ material success.
items.why: that 后面缺动词，主语 route 是单数，用三单 involves。
items.src: I’ll take the happy route that involves material success. Thank you.

items.s: Thanks for your ___ in the project.
items.why: your 后面需要名词，填名词。

items.s: One of your ___ is it's far easier to achieve our material desires than it is to renounce them.
items.why: one of your 后面接复数名词，填 insights。
items.src: I think it’s quicker in some ways. One of your insights is it’s far easier to achieve our material desires than it is to renounce them.

items.s: That was a really ___ comment.
items.why: a really ___ comment：后面是名词 comment，描述它，填形容词。

items.s: I quipped that the reason to win the game is to be ___ of it.
items.why: to be ___ of：be 后面描述状态，填形容词（be free of 摆脱）。
items.src: I quipped that the reason to win the game is to be free of it,

items.s: I love the ___ of working for myself.
items.why: the ___ of：冠词 the 后面需要名词，填名词。

items.s: You play the games, you win the games, and then ___, you get bored of the games.
items.why: 用逗号隔开、修饰整句（但愿），填副词。
items.src: so you play the games, you win the games, and then hopefully, you get bored of the games.

items.s: I'm ___ that things will get better.
items.why: I'm 后面描述人的感受，填形容词。

items.s: And then hopefully, you get ___ of the games.
items.why: get 后面描述人的感受，人觉得无聊用 -ed：bored。
items.src: so you play the games, you win the games, and then hopefully, you get bored of the games.

items.s: This movie is so ___.
items.why: 描述事物让人无聊，用 -ing：boring。

items.s: I ate snacks out of ___.
items.why: 介词短语 out of 后面接名词，填名词。

items.s: A lot of these games are very ___ and have many levels.
items.why: are very ___：very 后面描述事物，填形容词。
items.src: although a lot of these games are very enticing and have many levels that are relatively open-ended.

items.s: Stores use big sales to ___ shoppers.
items.why: to 后面接动词原形，填动词。

items.s: Although a lot of these games are very enticing and have many levels that are ___ open-ended.
items.why: 修饰后面的形容词 open-ended，填副词。
items.src: although a lot of these games are very enticing and have many levels that are relatively open-ended.

items.s: I can really ___ to your story.
items.why: can 后面接动词原形，填动词（relate to 有共鸣）。

items.s: Either you move to a different game or you play the game for the sheer ___ of it.
items.why: the sheer ___ of：冠词 + 形容词 sheer 后面需要名词，填名词。
items.src: and either you move to a different game or you play the game for the sheer joy of it.

items.s: The kids laughed ___ at the park.
items.why: 修饰动词 laughed（怎么笑），填副词。

items.s: Most of the gains in life come from ___ in the short term.
items.why: 介词 from 后面接名词，填名词 suffering（受苦）。
items.src: Another one of yours: most of the gains in life come from suffering in the short term so you can get paid in the long term.

items.s: Many people ___ from back pain.
items.why: 主语 people 后面缺动作，填动词。

items.s: I have ___ well-being and satisfaction to pain.
items.why: have + 过去分词（现在完成时），填 attached。
items.src: I have attached well-being and satisfaction to pain, not to what the pain gets me on the other side of it.

items.s: I sent the photo as an ___.
items.why: an 后面需要名词，填名词。

items.s: She is very ___ to her dog.
items.why: is very ___ to：very 后面描述人的感受，填形容词。

items.s: Suffering is mostly mental ___ and mental pain.
items.why: 形容词 mental 后面需要名词，和 pain 并列，填名词。
items.src: Suffering is mostly mental anguish and mental pain, and it just means you don’t wanna do the task at hand.

items.s: She gave me an ___ look when she heard the news.
items.why: an ___ look：后面是名词 look，描述它，填形容词。

items.s: The question is what's more ___: to suffer along the way or just to interpret it in a way that it's not suffering?
items.why: what's more ___：be 动词 + more 后面描述，填形容词。
items.src: and then the question is what’s more effective: to suffer along the way or just to interpret it in a way that it’s not suffering?

items.s: She works very ___.
items.why: 修饰动词 works（怎么工作），填副词。

items.s: The new cream had a good ___ on my skin.
items.why: a good ___：形容词后面需要名词，填名词。

items.s: To suffer along the way or just to ___ it in a way that it's not suffering?
items.why: to 后面接动词原形，后面还有宾语 it，填动词。
items.src: and then the question is what’s more effective: to suffer along the way or just to interpret it in a way that it’s not suffering?

items.s: That's one ___ of the story.
items.why: one ___ of：数词后面需要名词，填名词。

items.s: We hired an ___ for the meeting.
items.why: an 后面需要名词，这里指“人”，用 -er：interpreter。

items.s: You hear from a lot of ___ people, they look back and they say, “Oh the journey was the fun part.”
items.why: 后面是名词 people，描述它，填形容词。
items.src: You hear from a lot of successful people, they look back and they say, “Oh the journey was the fun part.”

items.s: He ___ finished the lash course.
items.why: 主语和动词 finished 中间，修饰动词，填副词。

items.s: That was actually the ___ part and I should have enjoyed it more.
items.why: the ___ part：冠词后、名词前，描述名词，填形容词。
items.src: That was actually the entertaining part and I should have enjoyed it more.

items.s: TV is my main ___ at night.
items.why: my main ___：所有格 + 形容词后面需要名词，填名词。

items.s: That was actually the entertaining part and I should have ___ it more.
items.why: should have + 过去分词，后面有宾语 it，填动词 enjoyed。
items.src: That was actually the entertaining part and I should have enjoyed it more.

items.s: We had a very ___ evening.
items.why: a very ___ evening：very 后、名词前，描述名词，填形容词。

items.s: It's a common ___.
items.why: a common ___：形容词后面需要名词，regret 也可以作名词。
items.src: It’s a common regret.

items.s: ___, the shop is closed today.
items.why: 句首、用逗号隔开，修饰整句（遗憾的是），填副词。

items.s: Try to put yourself in the ___ position you were in five years ago.
items.why: the ___ position：冠词后、名词前，描述名词，填形容词。
items.src: you can go back into your own life and try to put yourself in the exact position you were in five years ago, ten years ago, fifteen years ago, twenty years ago.

items.s: That's ___ what I wanted!
items.why: 修饰后面整个部分 what I wanted（正是），填副词。

items.s: …what was I feeling, what were my ___, what were my objectives…
items.why: your 后面需要名词，这里是复数，填 emotions。
items.src: You try to remember who was I with, what was I doing, what was I feeling, what were my emotions, what were my objectives,

items.s: She gets very ___ at weddings.
items.why: gets very ___：get 后面描述人的状态，填形容词。

items.s: And really try to ___ yourself back and see if there's any advice you'd give yourself.
items.why: try to 后面接动词原形，后面有宾语 yourself，填动词。
items.src: and really try to transport yourself back and see if there’s any advice you’d give yourself, anything you’d do differently.

items.s: Public ___ is cheap in this city.
items.why: 形容词 public 后面需要名词，作主语，填名词 transportation。

items.s: Just knowing what you know now in terms of your ___ and a little bit of age-related experience.
items.why: your 后面需要名词，填名词。
items.src: but just knowing what you know now in terms of your temperament and a little bit of age-related experience, how would you have done things differently?

items.s: My old car is a bit ___; sometimes it just won't start.
items.why: is a bit ___：be + a bit 后面描述，填形容词。

items.s: In terms of your temperament and a little bit of age-___ experience.
items.why: age-___ experience：描述名词 experience，填形容词 related。
items.src: but just knowing what you know now in terms of your temperament and a little bit of age-related experience, how would you have done things differently?

items.s: Are these two problems ___?
items.why: be 动词 are 后面描述主语，填形容词。

items.s: How would you have done things ___?
items.why: 修饰动作 done things（怎么做），填副词。
items.src: but just knowing what you know now in terms of your temperament and a little bit of age-related experience, how would you have done things differently?

items.s: What's the ___ between these two lashes?
items.why: the ___ between：冠词后面需要名词，填名词。

items.s: I think it's a ___ exercise to do.
items.why: a ___ exercise：名词前，描述名词，填形容词 worthwhile（worth 不放在名词前）。
items.src: I think it’s a worthwhile exercise to do.

items.s: This bag is not ___ the money.
items.why: is not ___ the money：后面直接跟价值/东西，用 worth（be worth + 名词）。

items.s: I would have done it with less anger, less emotion, less ___ suffering.
items.why: less ___ suffering：名词前，描述名词，填形容词。
items.src: For me, I would have done everything the same except I would have done it with less anger, less emotion, less internal suffering because that was optional. It wasn’t necessary.

items.s: I would have done it with less anger, less ___, less internal suffering.
items.why: less 后面需要名词，和 anger 并列，填名词。
items.src: For me, I would have done everything the same except I would have done it with less anger, less emotion, less internal suffering because that was optional. It wasn’t necessary.

items.s: This cream is for ___ use only. Don't eat it!
items.why: 名词 use 前面，描述它；只能涂在外面，所以是 external。

items.s: We fixed the problem ___, with no outside help.
items.why: 修饰动作 fixed（在内部解决），填副词。

items.s: Someone who can do the job at least ___, but maybe happily, is gonna be more effective.
items.why: 修饰动作 do the job（怎么做），填副词。
items.src: And I would argue that someone who can do the job at least peacefully, but maybe happily, is gonna be more effective than someone who has unnecessary emotional turmoil.

items.s: The beach is so ___ in the morning.
items.why: is so ___：so 后面描述主语，填形容词。

items.s: Someone who can do the job at least peacefully, but maybe ___, is going to be more effective.
items.why: 和 peacefully 并列，修饰 do the job，填副词。
items.src: And I would argue that someone who can do the job at least peacefully, but maybe happily, is gonna be more effective than someone who has unnecessary emotional turmoil.

items.s: Money can't buy ___.
items.why: 动词 buy 后面需要宾语（东西），填名词。

items.s: Someone who has unnecessary ___ turmoil.
items.why: 后面是名词 turmoil，描述它，填形容词。
items.src: And I would argue that someone who can do the job at least peacefully, but maybe happily, is gonna be more effective than someone who has unnecessary emotional turmoil.

items.s: Well, you end up with a series of ___ successes, right?
items.why: 后面是名词 successes，描述它，填形容词。
items.src: Well, you end up with a series of miserable successes, right?

items.s: He failed the test ___.
items.why: 修饰动作 failed（失败得很惨），填副词。

items.s: Too much stress can cause ___.
items.why: 动词 cause 后面需要宾语（东西），填名词。

items.s: You end up with a series of miserable ___, right?
items.why: a series of + 形容词 miserable 后面需要复数名词，填 successes。
items.src: Well, you end up with a series of miserable successes, right?

items.s: She runs a very ___ lash business.
items.why: a very ___ business：very 后、名词前，描述名词，填形容词。
